entity.description:
Alex Faust was a prominent terrorist in Star City, well-known for his proficiency in bombs and explosives.

He launched an MGM-140 missile at Star City, but Team Arrow stopped Faust, as Mr. Terrific relocated the missile with a T-Sphere. Alex was brought into police custody, where he made a make-shift bomb out of a can of soda, allowing his boss Black Siren to assault to the police department and later the Bunker.

Alex Faust continued his operations, but was brought in to custody again by Green Arrow and Wild Dog, this time permanently.
